title: Croatian Fish Curry
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired curry made with snapper, a hint of Croatian spices, and a tangy brine.

ingredients.name: Jelly (optional)
ingredients.notes: Adds a sweet and tangy glaze

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the snapper fillets and sear until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove the fish and set aside.
Add the ginger and garlic to the pot and sauté until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the Croatian paprika, fish spice blend, and brine to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the fish to the pot and simmer until cooked through, about 8-10 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh cilantro and a drizzle of jelly (if using).
